📸 Leica Camera - A16 HOS3
Version: Universal 5 Beta 8.3
Device: Tested on RN11 only but should work on all devices supported by port originally
Supported: HOS3 and AOSP ( partial support ) A16 only
Download: HyperOS3 | AOSP

Notes: HyperOS and AOSP variants are different. Dont cross install. 

✅ What works
•  HOS3: all mods supported same as original port after using my settings here
•  AOSP: most aosp a16 lack parallel files, so dont turn on parallel processing in universal settings. video here

⚙️ Installation
• Disable APK verification before installing ( hyperos variant ) 

Credits
   • All original porters ( HolyBearHome and itzdfplayer_stash). i just added support for a16.
